purpose: Path renames awaiting repair, ruled-but-absent paths that are not findings, and roots that live outside this branch. Planned and external hits are counted as notes and never affect the exit code.

renames.why: the commander renamed the three advice files; nothing checked the references

renames_note: cockpit-rename refuses a --prefix X=Y run while any entry here whose OLD path contains an id token of prefix X still has outstanding tier 1 or tier 2 hits, and names the colliding token. An entry with no id token (a room move) never gates a prefix pass. Tier 3 hits are uncountable by construction: the one reference inside orders.json text can never be repaired, and counting it would deadlock the identifier pass forever.
planned_note: ruled by the commander or by the pilot but not yet on disk. A citation of one is a note, not a finding. Remove a row once the path exists; the checker reports a planned row whose path now resolves, so the list cannot rot quietly.
external_note: roots on other branches, in other trees, or outside the repository. Cited legitimately and not resolvable from this branch, so counted as notes.
